messages:
Alex: heads-up — handoff in ~10m. primary currently Sam, Mira you'll be next. noticed a small uptick of 5xx on embeddings in us-west, want to sync quick before I sign off. :wave:

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: service.errors.count(/v1/embeddings) > threshold (5m) — region: us-west-2 — p50 latency spike. Auto-incident created I-20240309-1423. Pager dispatched to #eng-oncall.

Sam: i'm still primary until 14:30 PT. Mira i'll walk you through the warmstart/fallback steps — main hypothesis is KV cache pressure on the legacy embed-small pool.

Mira: taking primary at 14:30. quick question — customers actually impacted or noisy internal jobs? any CLIs/tickets?

Alex: scope: ~2.1% of total embed requests failing with 5xx, spikes correlate with long sequences (>2048 tokens) from an analytics ingest job. No major customer escalations yet but latency is visible.

Sam: runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-kv-cache-evict — follow staged eviction first. metrics to check: redwood.serving.kv_cache_pressure, redwood.serving.request_errors{route="/v1/embeddings"}, and node health.

incident-bot: Incident I-20240309-1423 (P2) created and assigned to @Mira. Ops channel created: #incident-I-20240309-1423.

Mira: commands i'm running now — basic health checks (paste when needed):
```
# check runtime health
curl -sS http://runtime-usw2.internal:9000/health | jq .
# list runtime pods
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=redwood-runtime -o wide
# tail logs for embed pool
kubectl -n redwood logs -l pool=embed-small --since=10m | tail -n 200
```

Jordi: if it's kv pressure, prefer staged eviction instead of full restart. API to trigger eviction: curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" https://admin.redwood.internal/api/cache/evict -d '{"pool":"embed-small","percent":15}'

Mira: initiating staged eviction (15%) now. also scaling a warmstart replica to rotate KV shards:
```
kubectl -n redwood scale deploy/embed-small --replicas=0 && sleep 8 && kubectl -n redwood scale deploy/embed-small --replicas=1
```
Note: doing zero->one to force a fresh cache; doing it on one replica to limit impact.

Sam: while that's running, i'm flipping routing fallback to prefer-dedicated for embeddings for 15m to reduce load on the shared pool. CLI: `redwood route update --route /v1/embeddings --policy prefer-dedicated --ttl 900`

Mira: warmstart done — new pod healthy. observed error rate drop from ~3.8% -> 0.4% over last 3 mins. tailing logs show kv eviction messages and lower OOMs. keeping extra monitoring on for 30m.

Alex: great. customer impact for status page: "Intermittent embedding errors in US-WEST-2 affecting a small subset of large requests; mitigation in progress." Notify when we hit steady state.

Mira: will post to the incident channel and update status page. Also adding a quick checklist in the incident thread for followup (postmortem triggers if recurrence, make sure job uses shorter sequences or batched streaming).

Alex: handing over to Mira now — primary: Mira, secondary: Sam. Coverage gap: 6h window with no APAC primary flagged; @oncall-manager please assign an APAC backup.

oncall-manager: noted and assigning APAC secondary for the window. Also adding handoff checklist link: https://intranet.redwood/ops/handoff-checklist — include kv eviction steps, routing flip, and escalation matrix.

Mira: thanks all — i'll keep monitoring and will file a short postmortem if this recurs. :thumbsup:
